note: Read 2026-11-03. The Road Safety and Transport Rules and Regulations 2026 (in force 1 July 2026, repealing the Regulations 2021), linked from the BCTA's downloads page: s. 146, an applicant for an ordinary driving licence must be eighteen and have held a learner's licence at least six months (the BCTA's licensing page says the same; the learner's licence from seventeen); s. 150(1), a two-wheeler or light-vehicle licence is valid for five or ten years until the holder turns seventy (yearly renewals after seventy, on a doctor's certificate, aren't held). Schedule-I, item 15: Nu 100 for the driving licence per annum and Nu 100 for the licence card; the two are held together for each term, as Albania's two payments are: Nu 600 for five years and Nu 1,100 for ten (100 a year times the years, plus the card; my arithmetic, the Schedule printing no term's total). The test booking fee (Nu 75 for a light vehicle) and the learner's licence (Nu 100) aren't held. No identity card and no exchange list were read.
